topology: Oriented spin four-dimensional left Weyl theory. Ordinary untwisted Z12 flavor, independent of fermion parity, no nonorientable backgrounds, no separate gauging of R charge, partner parity or higher form symmetry. Compare all principal backgrounds for SU(5) x Z12 and SM/Gamma x Z12 by restriction of actual representations.
center_convention: (g3,g2,e^{i theta}) maps to diag(e^{-2i theta}g3,e^{3i theta}g2) in SU(5). Fiber character normalized to 6Y.
index_convention: On S2 x S2 integral ch2 of a line with c1=a A+b B equals ab; fundamental instanton may be given either orientation. Comparison uses exp(+2 pi i sum q index /12).
hash_note: The code verifies exact representation indices, ordinary and center-twisted examples, and all registered neutral charge pairs. Exhaustion of arbitrary spin backgrounds uses the analytic bordism computation in proof.md.
